name: task-recs-hardcodes-fixture-task-fqn
body: testutil::task_recs hardcodes the fixture task FQN foo/plan.phase-01.task-1 in every record it emits, so a single task_recs call models one task carrying every verb's edges. Limit: a fixture that needs two distinct task FQNs cannot be built from repeated task_recs calls. Upgrade when a test needs two distinct task FQNs: extend the builder to take the task FQN as a parameter or compose one task's edges per call.
